basic_details.job_title: IIT Hyderabad Project Technical Support III Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: IIT Hyderabad has invited applications from Indian nationals for one Project Technical Support-III post in an ICMR-funded project, "Targeting Lysosomal Cholesterol Sensing Membrane Transceptors for Therapeutic Intervention in Neurological Disorders". The pay is Rs. 28,000/- + 30%HRA a month for a project duration of 11 months, with a possibility of further extension. The essential qualification is MTech/MSc in any area of Life Sciences/Biotechnology with minimum 60% marks. Applications are made through a Google form by 12.11.2026.

content_sections.heading: About IIT Hyderabad
content_sections.text: IIT Hyderabad is an Indian Institute of Technology in Hyderabad. This post sits in a research project funded by ICMR, and the notice was issued on 03.11.2026.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals may apply. The essential qualification is MTech/MSc in any area of Life Sciences/Biotechnology with minimum 60% marks. Experience in molecular cloning, working with model organisms such as yeast and/or Drosophila. Experience with bioinformatic analysis of large data sets is a plus, but not mandatory. The age limit is 28 Years. The notice says the age limit is relaxed as per norms for candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC, women and physically handicapped candidates. It does not print the number of years of relaxation or a cut-off date for counting age. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The monthly compensation is Rs. 28,000/- + 30%HRA. The project runs for 11 months, with a possibility of further extension based on performance and funding availability.

content_sections.heading: IIT Hyderabad Project Technical Support-III Job Description
content_sections.text: To conduct project-related experimental research work, analyse and interpret data assigned by the PI.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Hyderabad Project Technical Support-III
content_sections.text: Fill in the Google form at https://forms.gle/2Hr2tjqXzuCiq9Rq8 by 12.11.2026. Complete every part of the form, because incomplete applications will not be evaluated. For queries, write to Dr. Rahul Kumar ( [email protected] ) or Dr. Indranil Malik ( [email protected] ).

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted for the interview based on their academic records and relevant work experience. Only shortlisted candidates will be notified by email about the online interview date. Meeting the eligibility criteria alone does not guarantee a call for an interview. The interview date is not given in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The PI reserves the right to leave the position vacant if no suitable candidate is found. Incomplete applications will not be evaluated. The notice states the project extension as a possibility, depending on performance and funding availability.
